title: Agent Black Box
description: Operational view of an Agent Black Box installation. Every series is aggregate; no tenant, project or user is ever a label.

panels.title: Ingestion success, 30 days
panels.description: Share of ingestion requests that were durably accepted (committed / (committed + error)) over 30 days. Client refusals (4xx) are not counted. Objective: 99.95%.

panels.title: Error budget left
panels.description: Share of the 30-day error budget not yet spent. 100% means no server-side ingestion errors; 0% means the budget is gone.

panels.title: Burn rate, last hour
panels.description: How many times faster than allowed the error budget is being spent over the last hour. 1 uses it exactly in 30 days; 14.4 pages.

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Scrape targets of the API and the worker that are reachable.

panels.title: Not-ready checks
panels.description: Readiness checks currently failing on any API process. 0 is healthy.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts of this installation firing in Prometheus right now.

panels.title: Ingestion error ratio and the burn thresholds
panels.description: Server-side failure share of ingestion requests (5 minute and 1 hour windows) against the page threshold of 0.72% (14.4 times the budget).

panels.title: Request rate and server errors
panels.description: All API requests per second and the share of them that answered 5xx.

panels.title: Ingestion requests by outcome
panels.description: Ingestion requests per second. committed = durably accepted; rejected = refused as the client's fault (4xx); error = failed on our side.

panels.title: Events received and refused
panels.description: Telemetry events per second accepted for storage, and refused events or batches per second by reason.

panels.title: Acknowledgement latency
panels.description: Time from the start of an ingestion request to its answer: median, 95th and 99th percentile.

panels.title: Share answered within one second
panels.description: Share of ingestion requests answered in 1 second or less (5 minute and 1 hour windows). The ticket alert fires below 99%.

panels.title: Accepted bytes
panels.description: Request body bytes per second of accepted telemetry batches.

panels.title: Artifact uploads
panels.description: Artifact uploads that were not stored, per second by reason.

panels.title: Oldest waiting job
panels.description: Age of the oldest due job that has not started, by job type. Sampled from the database; both API and worker report it, so the maximum is shown.

panels.title: Jobs waiting
panels.description: Due jobs waiting to run, by job type (saturates at 10 000).

panels.title: Jobs finished by outcome
panels.description: Jobs finished per second by outcome (succeeded, retried, dead_letter, lease_lost, superseded).

panels.title: Handler duration
panels.description: 95th percentile time a job handler ran, by job type.

panels.title: Handler failures
panels.description: Failed handler attempts per second by job type (retried or dead-lettered).

panels.title: Dead letters
panels.description: Alert notifications that exhausted their retries, and jobs dead-lettered in the last hour.

panels.title: Database circuit breaker
panels.description: State of the breaker per API process: 0 closed, 1 half-open, 2 open.

panels.title: Pool wait
panels.description: Time spent waiting for a database connection: median and 99th percentile.

panels.title: Readiness
panels.description: 1 when the named readiness check passes, 0 when it fails, plus changes of the overall answer in 15 minutes.

panels.title: Scrape-time database sample
panels.description: 1 when the last scrape-time database sample succeeded, 0 when queue, dead-letter and retention gauges are stale.

panels.title: Privileged database role
panels.description: 1 per reason the connected database role is too privileged. Should be empty or 0.

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: Seconds since each process started. A drop to zero is a restart.

panels.title: Controls: limiter, throttles, quotas, body cap
Limiter fail-open
panels.description: Decisions the shared limiter made locally because the database was unavailable, by scope.

panels.title: Limiter database calls
panels.description: Calls the shared limiter makes to the database per second, by outcome.

panels.title: Failed-authentication throttle
panels.description: Requests refused per second by the failed API key and failed session throttles, by scope.

panels.title: Quota refusals
panels.description: Writes refused per second because a project quota was reached, by quota.

panels.title: Body cap
panels.description: Refusals per second by the in-flight body byte budget, by reason, and the bytes held right now.

panels.title: Search
panels.description: Searches refused as busy per second by reason, and permits in use.

panels.title: Retention mode
panels.description: The effective retention mode of the newest report: off, dry_run or enforce.

panels.title: Since last retention pass
panels.description: Time since the newest retention report was written. Empty when there is none.

panels.title: Last backup age
panels.description: Time since the last successful backup known to the textfile collector. Empty when it reports nothing.

panels.title: Last backup size
panels.description: Total size of the last successful backup bundle.

panels.title: Last backup took
panels.description: Duration of the last successful backup.

panels.title: Last key rotation
panels.description: Time since the last successful alert-key rotation. Rotation is on demand; empty if never reported.

panels.title: Retention deleted
panels.description: Data removed by retention per hour, by kind (runs, events, rows, bytes).

panels.title: Retention failures and passes
panels.description: Retention failures by code and ticks finished by mode, per hour.

panels.title: Backup and rotation runs
panels.description: Backup and key rotation runs in the last day, by outcome.

panels.title: Alert deliveries
panels.description: Alert notification results per second by status.

panels.title: Alert delivery failures by reason
panels.description: Failed or dead-lettered alert notifications per second by fixed reason.

panels.title: Alert destinations
panels.description: Alert destinations by state (active, paused, failing).

panels.title: Open live streams
panels.description: Open live-stream connections per API process.

panels.title: Stream delivery lag
panels.description: Time from an event being stored to its delivery on a stream: median and 95th percentile.

panels.title: Trace export failures
panels.description: Failed trace export attempts per second. Empty unless tracing is on.
